summary: Phase J review — all backend changes verified end-to-end via 21 pytest tests against the deployed preview URL (Founder tier, social URLs, intake-approval workflow, /members/me/renew 410, free-form chapter creation). Frontend spot checks confirm Trendsetters logo in navbar, no Renew button on /profile, all 8 social inputs present, Omega hides hero editor, AOP Forms Add-link dialog has Picture upload section, chapter dialog uses free-text Input (not Select). 20/21 backend tests passed on first run; the remaining test (refresh) had a Python cookie-clearing API misuse — fixed in test code, then passed (21/21).

issues: With 13 admin tabs (Dashboard, Members, Chapters, Tiers, Events, Hours, Awards, Gear, Causes, Reports, Email, News, Pages) at 390px the visible row only shows Dashboard/Members/Chapters. The TabsList uses 'inline-flex whitespace-nowrap' on mobile but has no overflow-x:auto on the list itself — scrollWidth==clientWidth in DOM. Single-row height is 36px (good, not wrapping), but the other 10 tabs are clipped off-screen with no visible horizontal scroll handle. Functional impact is low (tabs are reachable via swipe if container scrolls), worth verifying the parent wrapper has overflow-x:auto + scrollbar-hide.

Field is <input type=month> (yyyy-MM) per the label 'Month/Year — requires admin approval'. The backend stores whatever ISO-ish string is sent (e.g. '2017-07' or '2017-07-07'). No UX issue — just noting the format mismatch warning if a full date is ever pasted in.
Radix DialogContent 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' a11y warnings still present (pre-existing from iter-12).

action_items: (Optional) Confirm Admin TabsList horizontal-scroll on real mobile devices — the test detected scrollWidth==clientWidth at 390px. If the parent wrapper has overflow-x:auto it's fine; if not, add 'overflow-x-auto scrollbar-hide' to the TabsList on mobile to ensure the 10 hidden tabs are reachable.
(Optional, low priority) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to ChapterDialog & related admin dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Sanitize intake_completed_at on PUT /members/me — accept either yyyy-MM (current frontend) or yyyy-MM-DD and normalise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~5310 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into route modules (auth, members, events, news, omega, form_links, tiers, chapters, admin) under /app/backend/routes/ before further growth.

Admin RBAC for /admin/pending-intake-changes and /admin/members/{id}/intake-completion-review uses admin_tab_dep('members'), which includes membership_manager. Confirmed by tests that 'mm.tx' style admins CAN approve/reject intake changes. That's likely intended (membership_manager controls member data) but worth confirming with product.
intake_review_log array on the user doc grows unbounded with every approve/reject. Consider capping (slice last 50) or moving to a separate audit collection.

The 'no-op when same value' logic in update_me() uses string compare on stripped values — fine when both are ISO strings, but a sloppy client sending '2020-01' vs '2020-01-15' would create a pending change. Frontend field is type=month so this is safe today.
ChapterIn accepts any name (good for spec), but there's no uniqueness constraint on chapter name in MongoDB — duplicates can be created. Consider a unique index or pre-insert check.
test_credentials: Used admin@clubhaven.app / Admin123! and member@clubhaven.app / Member123! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Test data created via API and cleaned up in-test: 3 TEST_ chapters (Carolinas/Midwest/Northeast — created and DELETEd), social URLs on member@clubhaven.app (left in place — they're realistic test URLs and exercise the directory social-icon rendering), intake_completed_at on member exercised through pending/approve/reject cycle (final state matches what the approve test expects: 2017-07-07).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_phase_j.py — 21 tests covering Founder tier (1), renew-410 (1), intake-approval workflow (6), social URLs (3), arbitrary chapter creation (3 parametrized + cleanup), auth refresh (1), and basic regression (5). Member intake_completed_at is now '2017-07-07' after the test run. Omega chapter currently has 0 tributes so BiographyBody large-portrait layout couldn't be exercised live — code is in /app/frontend/src/pages/Omega.jsx and main agent can self-verify by adding a tribute via admin UI.
